## Frequently asked questions about porn blockers


### What is the best porn blocking software?


The best porn blocking software depends on your goal. Tools like DNS filters and VPN blockers are effective for restricting access, while platforms like Relay combine blocking with accountability and behavioral support for long-term recovery.


### Do porn blockers actually work?


Porn blockers can be effective at reducing access to explicit content, but they work best when combined with accountability or behavior change strategies. On their own, many blockers can be bypassed or disabled.


### What’s the difference between DNS, VPN, and app-based blockers?


DNS blockers filter website requests at the network level, VPN blockers route all traffic through a filtered connection, and app-based blockers work directly on your device or browser. VPN blockers are typically the hardest to bypass.


### Can you bypass porn blockers?


Many basic porn blockers can be bypassed using VPNs, alternative browsers, or device settings. More advanced solutions include tamper protection, accountability features, or network-level filtering to reduce bypass risk.


### What’s the best way to quit porn long term?


The most effective approach combines blocking tools with behavioral support, accountability, and habit change. Blocking access helps in the short term, but long-term success requires addressing the triggers and patterns behind the behavior.

## 7. CleanBrowsing: DNS-Based Internet Filter


[CleanBrowsing](https://cleanbrowsing.org/filters/) provides network-level porn filtering at the DNS layer, creating a simple yet effective barrier against adult content without requiring software installation on every device.


### How DNS Filtering Works


CleanBrowsing operates on the Domain Name System (DNS) infrastructure, functioning as a specialized DNS resolver that screens website requests before they reach your devices. Whenever you type a website address, your device sends a DNS query to translate that domain name into an IP address. CleanBrowsing intercepts these queries and blocks access to domains identified as pornographic or obscene.


This technology offers several advantages over traditional blocking methods:


-


Works at the network level, affecting all connected devices simultaneously


-


Operates independently of browsers or operating systems


-


Requires no software installation on individual devices


-


Supports encrypted DNS protocols including DNS-over-HTTPS, DNS-over-TLS, and DNSCrypt for enhanced privacy


The system effectively blocks known adult websites, obscene content, and enforces Safe Search on major platforms like Google, Bing, and YouTube. CleanBrowsing's approach is particularly valuable for limiting access to mixed-content sites like Reddit that contain both appropriate and inappropriate material.


### Implementation Across Devices


CleanBrowsing can be deployed in two primary ways: at the router level or on individual devices.


For comprehensive home protection, router-level implementation is most effective as it automatically covers all connected devices including smart TVs, gaming consoles, and IoT devices that might not support local installations. This method requires changing your router's DNS settings, typically taking less than five minutes to configure.


Alternatively, for protection outside your home network, CleanBrowsing offers apps for Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android.


For Android users specifically, the app offers enhanced features like automatic configuration and hardening options that prevent unintentional removal. Similarly, the Windows application includes password protection and can disable access to Internet Options to prevent circumvention.


### Payment and iOS Drawbacks


CleanBrowsing offers both paid and free options, with different features based on your selected plan.


Unfortunately, for users of iOS-based technology like iPhones, MacBooks and iPhones, DNS filtering is often easy to bypass. Apple’s technology utilizes a sire-memory feature that can allow users to access explicit content without alerting a filtering software like CleanBrowsing. For those working to overcome porn addiction, this can pose a significant drawback.


## 6. Antidopamine: VPN-Based Porn Blocking Solution


[Antidopamine](https://antidopamine.com/stop-porn/best-porn-blocker/#buy_now) is an emerging porn blocking software that[harnesses VPN technology](https://www.joinrelay.app/blog/ai-and-sex-addiction) to eliminate access to adult content across your devices.


Unlike traditional blockers or parental controls, this technical solution takes a fundamentally different approach by routing all internet traffic through a secure filter designed with one purpose: completely blocking pornographic material.


### VPN Filtering Technology


Antidopamine uses a[Virtual Private Network (VPN)](https://www.antidopamine.com/stop-porn/best-porn-blocker/) as its core blocking mechanism, which proves more effective than standard DNS or browser-based blockers. This approach creates a secure tunnel for your internet connection that automatically filters out adult content before it reaches your device.


### Why VPN-Based Blocking Is So Effective


VPN-based porn blockers work differently from traditional filters because they sit between your device and the entire internet—not just your browser.


When you try to visit a website, your request doesn’t go directly to that site. Instead, it first passes through a secure VPN server. This server acts as a gatekeeper, inspecting every request before anything is allowed through.


Instead of reacting after a page loads, the VPN stops requests at the source. If a domain is flagged as pornographic—or even if it’s serving adult ads—the request is blocked instantly. The content never reaches your device.


Because all internet traffic flows through the VPN tunnel, the filter applies across your entire device, including:


-


Browsers


-


Apps


-


Social media platforms


-


Embedded ads and pop-ups


This means you’re not just blocking porn sites—you’re also blocking adult content that appears inside other platforms.


The VPN wraps your internet activity in encryption, forming a secure tunnel between your device and the server.


This protects your activity from outside parties like ISPs or public networks, while ensuring all filtering happens in a controlled, private environment.


Traditional blockers operate inside a browser or app, which makes them relatively easy to disable or work around.


VPN filtering works at the system level. If your device is connected to the internet, it’s going through the filter—no matter what app or browser you use.


Unlike tools that rely on time limits or temporary overrides, VPN blockers enforce a simple rule: if it’s blocked, it’s blocked.


There’s no “just this once” option, which eliminates the internal negotiation that often leads to relapse.


Once installed, the VPN activates automatically and runs in the background at all times.


That means:


-


No need to manually turn it on


-


No gaps in protection after restarting your device


-


No vulnerable moments where access is temporarily restored


VPN-based blocking works because it doesn’t rely on willpower—it changes the structure of your internet access itself.


Every request follows the same path:


Request → VPN filter → Allowed or blocked


By controlling that pathway, it removes access at the exact point where bad decisions would normally happen—making it one of the most effective ways to create r


### Cross-Platform Implementation


Getting Antidopamine working across different devices follows a straightforward implementation process. Once installed, the VPN connection establishes automatically, requiring minimal technical knowledge from users. Furthermore, the system continues protecting your devices even after rebooting, without needing manual reconnection.


For devices that require specific DNS settings for always-on VPN operation, Antidopamine provides simple configuration instructions. This ensures consistent protection across mobile platforms alongside desktop implementations. This uniformity addresses a common frustration with other blocking solutions that perform inconsistently across different operating systems.


Essentially, you don't need to search for different types of porn blockers depending on which platform you're using. This makes Antidopamine particularly valuable if you use multiple devices throughout your day, or if your household contains a variety of Apple, Android, and Google products.


### Bypass Protection Measures


Antidopamine acknowledges an uncomfortable truth about traditional porn blockers: many people actually use VPNs to circumvent blocking rather than enforce it. In essence, this solution turns that dynamic on its head, using the very technology often employed to access restricted content as the method to block it.


The system's[automatic startup and persistent operation](https://www.antidopamine.com/stop-porn/best-porn-blocker/vpn-instructions/) create additional layers of bypass protection. Moreover, because the filtering occurs at the network level rather than browser level, common workarounds like switching browsers or using incognito mode become ineffective.
